name: Cincinnati
station_name: OHIO RIVER AT MARKLAND DAM NEAR WARSAW, KY
offset_note: Markland Dam, about 61 river miles downstream
source: U.S. Geological Survey, NWIS daily values (00060, statistic 00003)
flag_rule: USGS code A is measured and P provisional; any code with e (estimated) or an ice code is estimated.
notes: USGS computes daily discharge from the gauge's water level through a rating curve (stage-discharge relation), adjusted by shifts after each field measurement, and approves a year of data some months after it ends (USGS).
USGS has only 15-minute flow at Cincinnati itself, from October 2024, so this is the Ohio River at Markland Dam, about 61 river miles downstream, from 1970 (USGS).
Markland is just below a lock and dam; flow passing it is set partly by how the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers operates the dam (USGS, USACE).
USGS approval codes: {'A': 19643, 'A:e': 373, 'P': 316, 'A:R': 289}. A (approved) is measured, P (provisional) is provisional, and any code with e (estimated) or an ice code is estimated (USGS).
Skipped 0 days with no number (codes such as Ice or Eqp: none) and 0 negative values (USGS).
